stages.name: Requirements Analyst
stages.instruction: Analyze the original source packet and produce only the Stage 1 requirements-analysis handoff defined by your agent contract.

stages.name: Delivery Refinement Analyst
stages.instruction: Consume only the supplied Stage 1 handoff. Produce delivery decomposition, acceptance criteria and the assurance handoff defined by your agent contract. Do not consult or reconstruct the original source packet.

stages.name: Assurance Analyst
stages.instruction: Consume only the supplied refinement/acceptance-criteria handoff. Produce behavioural test and assurance coverage defined by your agent contract. Do not consult or reconstruct earlier source material.
